items.question: Do we own the prompts, code and fine-tuned weights at handover?
items.answer: Yes. Everything runs in your own cloud or private VPC and transfers to your GitHub organization with zero lock-in licensing.

items.question: How long does a typical AI agent deployment take?
items.answer: Discovery sprints finish in 2 weeks. Full production rollouts with telemetry and human escalation typically launch within 4 to 6 weeks.

items.question: How do you prevent hallucinations on customer-facing actions?
items.answer: Every external tool call passes deterministic JSON schema validation, confidence thresholds and automatic human escalation rules.

items.question: Can you integrate directly with Modrix Commerce and our existing ERP?
items.answer: Yes. We connect cleanly with REST/GraphQL commerce backends, HubSpot, Salesforce, Postgres, Stripe and internal webhooks.
